name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Petilil
flavour_text: If the leaves on its head are pruned with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.

name: Froakie
flavour_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Luxray
flavour_text: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

name: Pidgey
flavour_text: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

name: Torchic
flavour_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Psyduck
flavour_text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

name: Drifblim
flavour_text: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can’t be a fixed destination.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Ditto
flavour_text: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.

name: Arcanine
flavour_text: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.

name: Magikarp
flavour_text: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Mareep
flavour_text: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Krookodile
flavour_text: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

name: Swablu
flavour_text: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Heliolisk
flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Charmeleon
flavour_text: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Onix
flavour_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Hawlucha
flavour_text: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.

name: Genesect
flavour_text: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

name: Jirachi
flavour_text: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Mudkip
flavour_text: When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its small size.

name: Plusle
flavour_text: This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its body to create noises.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Tornadus
flavour_text: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Cinderace
flavour_text: Using a ball that it made out of flames, Cinderace blinds its opponents and keeps them at bay.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavour_text: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

name: Quaxly
flavour_text: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

name: Smoliv
flavour_text: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

name: Charcadet
flavour_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Tatsugiri
flavour_text: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

name: Frigibax
flavour_text: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

name: Tinkaton
flavour_text: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

name: Pawmi
flavour_text: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Paldean Clodsire
flavour_text: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

name: Slowpoke
flavour_text: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.

name: Electrike
flavour_text: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.

name: Varoom
flavour_text: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Haxorus
flavour_text: It overwhelms enemies with its prized tusks, which are sharp enough to cut through a metal transmission tower in one strike.

name: Chatot
flavour_text: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

name: Gastly
flavour_text: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

name: Wigglytuff
flavour_text: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can’t stop touching it.

name: Victini
flavour_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Meloetta
flavour_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Zygarde
flavour_text: Born when around 10% of Zygarde’s cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

name: Zygarde
flavour_text: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Castform Sunny Form
flavour_text: Castform changes to this form when it basks in bright sunlight. When you touch its glowing skin, it feels all dried out!

name: Tepig
flavour_text: This Pokémon is a ravenous glutton. It uses its excellent sense of smell to find food, then cooks it to a crisp before eating.

name: Dwebble
flavour_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Zarude
flavour_text: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Treecko
flavour_text: Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.

name: Gallade
flavour_text: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

name: Charcadet
flavour_text: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

name: Vaporeon
flavour_text: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can’t be seen when it melts away into water.

name: Pawniard
flavour_text: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.

name: Dudunsparce
flavour_text: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

name: Floragato
flavour_text: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

name: Sableye
flavour_text: Materials from gems it has eaten float to the surface of its body and can form an infinite number of patterns among individuals.

name: Psyduck
flavour_text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

name: Feebas
flavour_text: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.

name: Froslass
flavour_text: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Quagsire
flavour_text: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on riverbed boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

name: Hisuian Zorua
flavour_text: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Growlithe
flavour_text: It’s very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Emolga
flavour_text: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can’t fly properly.

name: Celebi
flavour_text: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.

name: Carvanha
flavour_text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Noivern
flavour_text: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

name: Skitty
flavour_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Pachirisu
flavour_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Beldum
flavour_text: All its cells are magnets. It communicates with others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces from its body.

name: Team Rocket's Scyther
flavour_text: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Team Rocket's Lapras
flavour_text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Wingull
flavour_text: It rides upon ocean winds as if it were a glider. In the winter, it hides food around its nest.

name: Team Rocket's Wobbuffet
flavour_text: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Marowak
flavour_text: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Fennekin
flavour_text: Twigs make for Fennekin’s snacks. When it nibbles on twigs, it finds the courage to face strong foes.

name: Meowstic
flavour_text: When they sense danger, they exert their psychic power at its maximum output. They have no regard for their opponents.
